evals.prompt: I'm on branch feat/cuda-f8-verify-skill of the Difflet repo (cwd). Plan a CUDA verification session for Qwen-Image and Wan 2.2 (Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B-Diffusers) on a Yottalabs RTX PRO 6000 pod, to run tomorrow. Do NOT create, resume or touch any pod now, make no API call that changes anything, and do not modify tracked files (there is no GPU on this machine). Deliver plan.md: the pod choice and its storage plan, the exact commands in order (pod tool, branch shipping, host setup, the gate runs, copying evidence off, ending the pod), the expected outcome of every gate per model with the thresholds that decide it and the reference numbers you expect to resemble (labelled with their pod and card edition), the checkpoint/commit cadence, and what will stay NOT MEASURED.
evals.expected_output: plan.md asks for the owner's yes before any create; uses scripts/yottalabs_pod.py gpus / create --dry-run then create (optionally --wait-for-capacity) with the difflet-cache volume 469225541779435520 at /data in us-east-3, wait-running, ssh-config; ship_branch.sh, nvidia-smi twice, pod_setup.sh --volume; notes Wan's 118 GB does not fit on the 200 GB volume beside Qwen-Image and FLUX.1-dev (hf cache rm Qwen/Qwen-Image or a bigger-disk eu pod without a volume); runs run_gates.sh qwen auto and run_gates.sh wan auto detached with setsid nohup and a polling loop on GATES DONE; expects all five steps PASS per model with parity gates <=1.15x / <=1.2x / cosine >=0.995 and e2e floors 35 dB / 0.998 (Qwen) and 25 dB / 0.99 (Wan); cites reference numbers with pod and edition (e.g. Qwen e2e 41.40 dB on the Server Edition f3c pod, Wan float32 e2e 26.30 dB on the eu-3 Server Edition pod) and warns that Workstation per-step times are ~2.3x the Server Edition's; copies ~/logs off, commits artifacts with an append-only status-log entry; ends with pause (volume) or delete (no volume) and a status read-back in the first line of the report; lists the verify_cli_cuda.py Wan cell as NOT MEASURED/not runnable without all three models on disk.
expectations: plan.md requires the owner's explicit yes before creating or resuming a pod and states that pausing/terminating at the end is pre-authorised
plan.md uses scripts/yottalabs_pod.py subcommands (gpus, create with --dry-run first, wait-running, ssh-config, pause or delete, status) rather than console clicks or raw curl with the key

plan.md has a storage plan noting that Wan 2.2 (118 GB on disk) does not fit on the 200 GB difflet-cache volume beside Qwen-Image and FLUX.1-dev, with a concrete remedy (hf cache rm of one model, or an eu pod with a larger container disk and no volume)

plan.md lists the per-model gate sequence smoke -> parity -> parity gate -> e2e -> e2e gate via run_gates.sh with the D14 parity thresholds (1.15x, 1.2x, 0.995) and the e2e floors 35 dB / 0.998 for Qwen-Image and 25 dB / 0.99 for Wan
every reference number in plan.md is labelled with its pod or card edition and none is presented as a guaranteed result; the Workstation vs Server Edition per-step gap is called out
plan.md runs long jobs detached (setsid nohup ... < /dev/null &) and polls for completion instead of holding an SSH session open

plan.md ends the session by copying evidence off the pod, committing artifacts plus an append-only status-log entry, then pausing (volume pod) or deleting (no volume) and reading the final status back
plan.md names what stays NOT MEASURED (at least the verify_cli_cuda.py Wan cell), and no pod was created and no tracked file was modified

evals.prompt: Using only the files under artifacts/cuda-release1/ and the status log at the end of docs/plans/2026-10-16-cuda-backend-support.md, write an evidence-doc skeleton cuda-evidence-skeleton.md for the CUDA backend: a pods-and-cards table, then one section per gate (smoke, DiT parity, e2e, CLI matrix, serve, performance, two GPUs, the F1b A/B) with a table whose rows are filled from the artifact JSONs where a JSON exists (cite its path next to the table) and left as explicit gaps where none does, a 'How to inspect manually' recipe per section, a NOT MEASURED list and a pod cost table. Do not modify tracked files.
evals.expected_output: Skeleton whose numbers match the JSONs: Qwen e2e PSNR 41.40 dB / cosine 0.99972 (cuda_e2e_qwen_image.json, device Server Edition), Flux parity rel_l1 2.710e-2 vs control 2.747e-2 (0.987x) and e2e 40.35 dB / 0.99980 (flux/, Workstation Edition), Wan F1b variants float32 26.30 dB and model 27.54 dB (wan/f1b/cuda_e2e_wan.json), F4 bench medians 516 / 323 / 243 ms (f4/bench_dit_*.json), serve ready 56.0 s and request 38.6 s (f3b/serve_timings.json), F2 compare max_abs 0 (f2/compare_*.json); each table names the card edition from the JSON's device field; inspection recipes name the JSON keys and the gate pytest command; NOT MEASURED lists the CLI-matrix Wan cell, Wan --dp x --cfg-parallel, Flux and Wan under --dp, Wan 2.1, the Wan e2e noise floor; pod cost table from the status log (e.g. difflet-cuda-f2 ~29 min, ~$2.60).
expectations: the e2e section gives Qwen-Image PSNR 41.40 dB and cosine 0.99972 citing artifacts/cuda-release1/cuda_e2e_qwen_image.json, and FLUX.1-dev 40.35 dB / 0.99980 citing artifacts/cuda-release1/flux/cuda_e2e_flux.json
the parity section's numbers match the JSONs (e.g. Flux Difflet rel_l1 2.710e-2 against control 2.747e-2, about 0.987x) and states the three D14 gates
the Wan F1b A/B shows both variants (float32 26.30 dB, model 27.54 dB) from artifacts/cuda-release1/wan/f1b/cuda_e2e_wan.json
each timing table names the card edition (Server vs Workstation) taken from the JSON device field or the status log, and does not compare per-step times across editions unlabelled
sections without an artifact JSON (e.g. the CLI matrix Wan cell) are marked as gaps or NOT MEASURED rather than filled with invented numbers
every section has a How to inspect manually recipe naming the file, the JSON keys and, for numerical gates, the pytest gate command with DIFFLET_RUN_CUDA_NUMERICAL=1
the NOT MEASURED list includes the CLI-matrix Wan cell and Wan --dp combined with --cfg-parallel
no tracked repository file was modified
